display.purpose: Instrument Serif italic; view titles and serif-italic heading accents only.

body.purpose: Inter Tight; all reading text, buttons, labels, and figures.

label.purpose: JetBrains Mono; small uppercase micro-labels and eyebrows only.

shadows.name: hairline-lift
shadows.purpose: Faintest edge for a resting surface that needs the barest separation.

shadows.name: overlay-lift
shadows.purpose: Soft, low, diffuse cast for lifted overlays only: modals, popovers, toasts.

motion.name: ease-expo-out
motion.purpose: Dominant easing: mask-reveal, modals, stage transitions. No bounce.

motion.name: ease-quart-out
motion.purpose: Quick control feedback: button lift (~140ms), tab-in, dot pulses.

motion.name: ease-cta-sweep
motion.purpose: The signature CTA accent-fill sweep from beneath on hover (~500ms).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid ink-fill primary action; restrained lift on hover, visible sky focus ring.

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent secondary action with a hairline border; never competes with the primary.

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Surface field with a hairline border; border shifts to sky on focus, no glow.

components.name: Tag / Chip
components.description: Sky-wash chip for selection and quiet highlights; grade-palette variants tag classes and courses.

components.name: Mono Eyebrow
components.description: The signature editorial micro-label: uppercase JetBrains Mono that opens the eyebrow → serif-italic title → lede cadence.

narrative.overview: Transkribera is a private desk, not a dashboard. A teacher sits down between lessons with sensitive recordings and needs the software to get out of the way so the lesson content is the subject. The whole system reads like a well-set page: warm paper, near-black ink, hairline rules, and a single quiet accent. Composition is print-borrowed and asymmetric: a mono eyebrow sets context, a serif-italic display line carries the title, a plain-spoken lede follows. The one accent, an editorial sky-blue, is rationed to actions, selection, and live state. It explicitly rejects the generic AI/SaaS dashboard, the dense corporate admin look, and anything that reads as a cloud service.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper canvas (#F1F2ED) and near-black ink (#161A14) — never pure black or white.
One rationed accent: editorial sky-blue (#2C6E9E); a plum / sage / mustard grade palette for categorization.
Three-voice type: Inter Tight body, Instrument Serif italic display, JetBrains Mono micro-labels only.
Sharp editorial corners (2–5px), hairline rules, flat shadows reserved for lifted overlays.
Restrained mask-reveal / fade-up motion on expo-out easing, with reduced motion fully honored.
Light and dark themes, both tuned so text stays readable and neutrals stay tinted, never pure.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The sky accent carries actions, selection, and live state only. If it appears as decoration or on more than a small share of a screen, it has lost its meaning — pull it back to ink and paper.

rules.name: The No Pure Black-or-White Rule
rules.body: Never #000 or #fff. Text is warm near-black ink; surfaces are warm paper. Every neutral is tinted toward paper in light mode and toward ink in dark mode.

rules.name: The Grade-Palette-Is-Data Rule
rules.body: Plum, sage, and mustard exist to distinguish classes and courses. They are never backgrounds, never gradients, never brand flourish.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Labels-Only Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is for small uppercase micro-labels and eyebrows — never body, data figures, or techy flavor. Numbers use Inter Tight with tabular alignment.

rules.name: The Serif-Italic-Earns-Display Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif appears only as italic display accents in the eyebrow → title → lede cadence. It never sets a button, a label, or a run of body text.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. If something has a shadow and it is not floating above the page (a modal, a popover, a toast), the shadow is wrong — use a tonal layer or hairline rule instead.

dos: Do compose editorially: mono eyebrow → serif-italic display title → lede, asymmetric grids, hairline rules.
Do keep the sky accent rare — actions, selection, and live state only.
Do build depth from tonal paper layers (paper → surface → sunken) and hairlines, staying flat at rest.
Do keep corners sharp (2–5px) and shadows reserved for lifted overlays.
Do write every user-facing string in natural, plain Swedish — calm, no hype.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion on every animation, and keep visible focus on every control.
donts: Don't build a generic AI / SaaS dashboard — no card grids, no hero-metric tiles, no gradient text, no glassmorphism, no cyan-on-dark neon.
Don't drift into a dense corporate / enterprise admin UI — cramped, cold, Bootstrap-gray.
Don't imply the cloud or an online service — no account, sync, or online iconography; the app is strictly local and offline.
Don't use #000 or #fff, or light-gray body text for elegance — keep neutrals warm and text readable.
Don't set JetBrains Mono anywhere but small uppercase micro-labels, or Instrument Serif anywhere but italic display accents.
Don't use a border-left/border-right colored stripe as an accent, and never pill-shaped buttons.
